scope: Distinct coding harness projects, including explicit fork lineage and maintenance/restricted-license cases. SDK packages, configurations and model choices are not additional projects. Catalog membership is not successful trial evidence.
maintenance_method: Read public GitHub repository API fields full_name, archived, disabled, pushed_at and license, and separately inspect explicit maintenance declarations in the official README. A recent push is not a maintenance-quality guarantee.
integration_target: An existing canonical Loop owns reasoning and all effects. A qualified CLI adapter may implement one isolated semantic model step, with its own effect tools disabled and every provider request brokered through the existing engine model authority. A catalog entry grants no runtime authority.
global_qualification_requirements: Pin exact harness release, source revision and dependency environment before claiming compatibility.
Check installed help and source against these moving documentation references.
Use separate task-owned config, state, cache and workspace paths; retain approved session records.
Prove tool registry closure, discovery suppression, network confinement, cancellation and child-process cleanup independently.
Broker every physical provider request, including retries, compaction, summaries and auxiliary model calls; reject any unapproved route.
Retain unknown provider usage and cost as unknown; CLI instance counts are not physical provider-call counts.
Do not replace the canonical solver with a CLI wrapper or credit a docs-only candidate as integrated.
Treat fork ancestry as a comparison control, not another independent experiment by default.

candidates.name: Pi coding agent

lineage.note: The official May 7, 2026 announcement documents the move and deprecated @mariozechner package scope.

headless.stdin: Prompt text is merged into the initial prompt.
headless.output: JSONL events; print mode also supports plain text.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Not established as one physical request; gateway must observe all requests.

controls: No built-in filesystem/process/network/credential permission system.
Documented external containerization patterns: Docker, Gondolin and OpenShell.
--no-tools disables all tools by default; --no-builtin-tools is narrower.
control_issues: Replacing the system prompt alone still appends context files and skills unless their discovery is disabled.
Installed versions may predate the documented flags.
RPC requires LF-delimited JSONL, not arbitrary Unicode line splitting.

candidates.name: Aider

headless.output: Terminal text; structured provider replies require separate extraction.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Architect mode explicitly uses multiple models; weak-model, summaries and other auxiliary requests must be measured and brokered.

controls: Ask mode is documented to answer without modifying files.
Documented read-only files, dry-run and confirmation controls.
Auto-commit and dirty-commit behavior have disable switches.
control_issues: Ask mode is not an OS sandbox or proof of zero auxiliary calls.
Automatic Git commits are enabled in the default coding workflow.
The scripting Python API is explicitly not a stable supported interface.

candidates.name: Goose

headless.stdin: --instructions - reads the instruction body from stdin.
headless.output: text, json or stream-json; exact emitted schema requires installed probe.

semantic_step.provider_requirement: Use the native OpenAI-compatible provider routed to engine broker, not an ACP or other CLI provider that applies its own permission mapping.
semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Context strategies, planning and retries may add requests; exact request inventory remains unqualified.

controls: Chat Only permission mode is documented to disable extension use and file modification.
Manual Approval, Smart Approval and Completely Autonomous modes are separate choices.
Docker and sandbox arrangements are documented.
control_issues: Headless mode cannot obtain interactive approvals.
GOOSE_MODE=auto is not a tool-disable mechanism.
--no-profile suppresses default extensions; do not add --with-extension, --with-builtin or a recipe that restores tools.
Current agent source skips tool requests in Chat mode; prove tool schemas are absent and plugin startup has no effects separately.
Native Chat mode is not equivalent to Chat mode delegated through another CLI provider.

candidates.name: Gemini CLI

headless.stdin: Headless scripting supported; exact framing pending adapter probe.

controls: Sandbox choices documented: Docker, Podman, macOS Seatbelt, Windows sandbox, gVisor and experimental LXC.
Trusted-folder and approval policies are separate controls.
control_issues: Do not assume a custom OpenAI base URL is supported because other Gemini-derived harnesses support it.
Sandbox behavior and defaults are platform/version dependent.

candidates.name: Qwen Code

lineage.note: README names Gemini CLI v0.8.2 as origin and says independent development replaced upstream syncing starting with Qwen v0.1.

headless.stdin: Accepts piped text; supports text and stream-json input formats.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Agent, team, goal, compaction, retry and summary paths need explicit suppression or broker observation.

controls: Approval modes and sandbox configuration are independent.
tools.disabled removes names from registry.
Whole-tool deny rules block builtins; MCP exclusion has distinct behavior.
control_issues: tools.core=[] disables nothing.
A nonempty core allowlist does not cover synthetic/system or dynamically discovered tools.
tools.eager defers tools; it does not disable them.
--safe-mode also disables settings-sourced permission and sandbox configuration; it is not a security profile.
Headless --yolo does not enable a sandbox.

candidates.name: OpenHands CLI

lineage.note: OpenHands/OpenHands currently presents Agent Canvas; this entry identifies the runnable CLI, not that control center.

maintenance.note: A direct raw-source follow-up exposed this declaration, which the earlier rendered GitHub page did not show. Prefer the current source declaration over that cached rendering.

headless.stdin: Use documented task file or task argument.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Condenser and optional critic/security-model work may add calls or routes; all must be brokered.

controls: --always-approve and --llm-approve are documented approval modes.
Local, server and container arrangements must be distinguished.
control_issues: An approval flag does not hide all effect tools.
Current AgentStore._resolve_tools returns get_default_cli_tools for a new session and _apply_runtime_config overwrites agent.tools. Persisting tools=[] alone does not disable its tools.
Current CLI context builder enables project, user and public skill loading; an empty work directory is not complete discovery suppression.
Do not infer containment from OpenHands branding or from the presence of a serve command.

candidates.name: mini-SWE-agent

lineage.note: Distinct simplified implementation; current project recommends v2 and documents migration from v1.

headless.stdin: Preconfigure first-run state and supply a task to avoid prompting.
headless.output: Saved JSON trajectory; terminal text is not the authoritative result.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Agent loop can make multiple calls. Its native interface expects executable actions and a submission action.

controls: confirm, yolo and human modes.
Local environment has no isolation.
Docker, Singularity, SWE-ReX and experimental bubblewrap environments are documented.
control_issues: -y disables confirmations rather than disabling execution.
A model that returns bare semantic JSON does not satisfy the default command/action parser.
A custom inert environment or exact adapter requires its own tests and must not be mislabeled stock CLI integration.

candidates.name: SWE-agent
controls: Official example executes in Docker through SWE-ReX.

control_issues: An issue-solving tool loop is not automatically a single semantic model step.
Prefer mini-SWE-agent for new implementation according to maintainers; preserve this as a distinct reference arm.

candidates.name: Cline CLI

lineage.counting_rule: One harness family, not one candidate per client.

headless.stdin: Current CLI README says --json requires a prompt argument or piped stdin.
headless.output: NDJSON agent events; source example extracts agent_event.event.text.

semantic_step.extra_model_requests: Task summaries, subagents, retries and auxiliary features require registry closure and request accounting. Default one-shot mode includes spawn and team tools; --yolo disables those by default but enables submit_and_exit and does not disable ordinary tools.

controls: CLI --auto-approve boolean.
CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS restricts shell commands.
SDK tool policies can hide individual tools.
CLI documentation lists sandbox and isolated data directory controls.
control_issues: SDK controls cannot be silently claimed as CLI flags.
Tool policy omissions default to enabled and auto-approved in the documented SDK.
--auto-approve false is not a tool-disable flag.
Moving docs differ on short flags and defaults; freeze and inspect the installed CLI.
